items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED LESSONS (observed unless marked guess/uncertain)

CONTROLS: WASD moves; arrow keys fire. E drops a bomb at feet (~1s fuse, ~2-tile radius); bomb count decrements on placement. Bombs damage self. Q and Space do nothing. Diagonal/single-axis moves stall against rocks whose hitboxes exceed their sprites; reposition lanes rather than pushing. Mixing a movement key with a fire arrow works for moving+shooting simultaneously.

TECH X: pill pedestal in the two-poop room grants Tech X (pickup text 'Laser ring tears'); re-offered on re-entry. Firing produces a ~1s lingering laser ring at a fixed offset (~0.15–0.2 room-units) along the firing direction on the player's row/column; rocks block it; alignment matters. The red squiggly ring is my own laser effect, NOT a lock marker or enemy telegraph (uncertain). Lasers kill white-faced chasers safely at range — but only when aimed down the correct row/column; misfires cost hearts.

KEYS: a run can start with keys counter 01 (a key held) though no key pickup was observed this run; earlier runs the counter stayed 00 even after a key-shaped pickup. Keys never actually spent/used — whether approaching the rock-field keyhole door with 01 auto-opens/uses it is UNTESTED. Red-lidded brown barrels/containers suspected key-locked (guess; never opened).

CHESTS/CONTAINERS: gray chests open by contact (TNT room lore); the left-wall gray plates in the TNT room are inert decorations (confirmed). Coin pot in the two-poop room breaks on contact, yields a coin (coins 00→01) — don't waste lasers. Torch-room center gray chest fully sealed by indestructible rocks — tested left, top, right; ABANDON. Chest in the dark chest room ringed with white spikes is untouchable.

BOMBS — FAILED STRATEGY: bombing the two-poop room center rock cost a heart and broke nothing; warping away does NOT outrun the fuse. Never bomb at low hearts or adjacent to self. Rocks judged indestructible.

HAZARDS: GREEN GLOWING BLOBS damage on contact — keep away; they transform (winged/spread/large fast green forms) and a large white-faced blob form exists (hit me this run, -1 heart). Rock field is a severe heart-drainer; enemies cluster near its hatches. Observed there: small spiky pellet projectiles (guess: spawner/turret near bottom-right), spiked-wheel wall decorations, white-faced chasers, blue-tear shooters, a spiked-ring enemy, a gray round enemy on/near the top hatch, and a spiky black rock ring with a gray enemy inside at room center. Corner torches damage on touch. Chasers wander close and deal contact damage quickly — do not walk toward one without firing first.

NEW LESSON (this run): entering the rock field with only 3 hearts, Tech X and a key still drained all hearts to zero within minutes — chasers converge from multiple sides while I maneuver to the left keyhole door; at 1 heart any approach is fatal. Preferred route remains: get Tech X first (torch room → two-poop room) before any rock-field trip, and never linger on hatch frames there. Consider clearing nearby enemies from distance BEFORE approaching the keyhole door, or skipping the door until more hearts can be gained.

PICKUPS: hearts need overlap (+1). Bomb-fuse sprite in TNT room is a BOMB PICKUP (auto-collects on overlap, harmless). Coin pickup tolerance unresolved (some gold specks never register).

HATCH/WARP MECHANICS: requires near-exact x-centering plus a sustained walk started ~0.1–0.2 units from the frame; standing on the frame blocks the warp — step back ~0.2, re-center, then hold the direction. Sometimes multiple attempts; on failure back off and re-center rather than pressing harder. All listed hatches were confirmed working this run.

MAP / ROUTES:
- Tutorial: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ rock field; bottom hatch x~0.49–0.50 ↔ torch room; right doorway y~0.47 ↔ dark chest room.
- Rock field: bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch x~0.50 ↔ TNT room; keyhole door on left wall ~x0.19–0.20, y~0.44–0.48.
- Torch room: top hatch x~0.50 ↔ tutorial; gold bottom-center hatch x~0.50, y~0.76–0.79 ↔ two-poop room (approach ~0.1 above, centered); safe left lane x~0.31–0.42 full height; right lane x~0.63 traversable down.
- Two-poop room: only exit is the top crown hatch x~0.50 (approach from ~0.1 below); poop piles regenerate and drop nothing; center rock indestructible; Tech X pedestal at center.
- TNT room (rock-field top exit): TNT barrels line left wall and mid-room, block movement, inert (don't shoot at close range); red-lidded brown barrels near left wall; top dark hatch x~0.50, y~0.15 ↔ pink-enemy room; bottom hatch ↔ rock field.
- Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies, rock wall right with a poop pile containing gold/blue flies, three dark teardrop pickups, gray chest with spiky black edges at left. Pink enemy behavior UNTESTED.
- Dark chest room (right of tutorial): chaser den; two red-lidded brown containers; central red-lidded chest in white spikes; black blob/pit shapes; gold/olive specks.

GOALS: hearts are the priority resource — survival gating matters more than doors. Open red-lidded/ringed containers, presumed key-locked. Probe the rock-field keyhole door only
with a confirmed key AND enough hearts; best attempted after thinning nearby enemies with Tech X lasers from a safe lane.

UNRESOLVED: whether the key counter 01 actually unlocks the keyhole door or needs a different key type; what opens the keyhole door; contents of the torch-room enclosed chest; nature of the dark teardrop pickups in the pink room; green blob effect beyond heart loss; exact coin pickup tolerance; whether lasers can open any chest through a rock ring (evidence: no); where to regain hearts after rock-field damage.
